history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian man with messy black hair and white wireless earbuds is taking a mirror selfie in a modern, minimalist bathroom. He is wearing a plain black oversized t-shirt and black cargo pants. His left hand is in his pocket, and he is holding a smartphone in his right hand, angled to capture his reflection. The bathroom features sleek, dark gray walls and a dark ceiling with integrated strip lighting that casts a soft glow. To the left, a white countertop with a sink and faucet is visible, reflecting the bright strip light. The floor is adorned with a striking black and white geometric tile pattern. The overall mood is cool, stylish, and contemporary, with a focus on clean lines and a monochromatic color palette. The lighting is dramatic, with strong contrasts between the illuminated areas and the shadows, highlighting the textures of the walls and the intricate floor design. The reflection in the mirror shows the man's profile and the dynamic patterns of the bathroom.
